name: Among Us - Impostor (Drama Afera League Server)
author: townofus-pl
description:
Impostor with the Reactor.Impostor plugin, for Town of Us (TOU-Mira) league matches.

Impostor and the plugin ship inside the image ghcr.io/townofus-pl/impostor. Wings pulls the image on every start, so a restart deploys the latest :league build.

Allocations: the primary allocation is the game port (UDP). A second allocation is the HTTP matchmaker port (HTTP_PORT). Put a TLS reverse proxy in front of it: Among Us accepts only an HTTPS matchmaker.

Source: https://github.com/townofus-pl/impostor-egg

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Impostor and Reactor.Impostor ship inside the server image (ghcr.io/townofus-pl/impostor).
# There is nothing to download. A reinstall only makes sure the server folder exists.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Nothing to install: Impostor ships in the image. Update by restarting the server."

variables.name: HTTP port
variables.description: Port of the HTTP matchmaker. Use the second allocation of this server. The TLS reverse proxy forwards to it.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: IP or DNS-only hostname that players use for game traffic (UDP). Leave empty to use the IP of the primary allocation.
